Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
So currently the 4 main independant clans have the following numbers
in vampires:
Group 2/3/4/5
Assamites: 26 / 2 / 10 / 1
Followers: 25 / 2 / 10 / 0
Giovanni: 25 / 2 / 10 / 0
Ravnos: 24 / 2 / 11 / 0

Assamites group 2 are +2 due to
Tariq advanced and Tegerius. Followers
are +1 in group 2 due to Kemintri
and Gios are at +1 due to Ambrogino.

This next set has 50+ new vampires, and from the checklist
so far it appears that all are either Rav/Ass/Fol/Gio.

I guess the starter only vampires are not included in the
50 new vampires mentioned for boosters so there is probably
62? new vampires. If we knock 2 off for oddities like new advanced
vampires or something for group 3 or something we are left with
15 vampires per clan.

We know that the four previewed vampires are half group 4,
half group 5.

It is unlikely that anything other than advanced vampires
will be added to group 3 as group 2 is too huge to permit
adding to gr 2/3.

Are we going to see group 4 brought up to 15 vampires per clan
like 3rd edition did for the sabbat clans? Can we expect 10/15/10/15
in the future and group 5 will be the larger of the two?

And how many expansions down the road are we away from
the camarilla clans getting rounded out in group 4 (1 prince!
in all group 4 for the cams right now).

What do we want to see grouping wise?

John P.
Winnipeg

On Sep 13, 2:13 pm, "John P." <jtpat...@mts.net> wrote:

There weren't 50 new vampires mentioned for boosters.

There are 50 rares, 50 uncommons, and 50 commons.
Historically when vampires are not listed separately, the uncommon
sheet is mixed with uncommon library cards and uncommon vampires.

We could have 10 new common vampires, or 10 new rare vampires.
or both.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=Checklist_LordsOfTheNight

Each booster pack contains 11 cards randomly selected from a set of
150 all-new cards (no reprints) consisting of 50 rares, 50 uncommons,
and 50 commons.

There could be anywhere from 2-12 new vampires in the starters.
Depends on how superstar the vampires are and how many reprints are
appropriate.

Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
> What do we want to see grouping wise?

The largest possible number of G4, as far as I'm concerned. I'd (I'll ?) be
quite disappointed if a star vampire like Ignazio didn't get enough new
friends to play with.

Of course, on the whole picture, balancing the groups 15/10 would be more
sensible ; but having begun on one foot, changing suddenly would, well,
create a disturbing unbalance.

Not to mention that the G5s we currently have are nigh unplayable because of
their lack of allies not only in their clan but in other sects as well
(like, poor G5 !Tremere with no other G5, and not even enough Camarilla G4
!!).

I'll always be in favor of finishing a group for all the clans before
beginning a new one with a sprinkle of vampires. It may seem the commercial
thing to do, but it makes for temporary wallpaper and therefore isn't good
for the game in the long run.

--
Orpheus
